profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | IOT | Analytics | Microservices | Java | Spring Boot | SQL | Agile | API
profile.summary: I’m an innovative, highly analytical, solution-driven, software engineer with experience in all aspects of the software development process in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.  Currently, I work on cloud-based web applications to help industrial businesses to run and configure analytics on their assets to prevent any accidents and to reduce maintenance cost. I have experience in software design, development, API implementation, POC, database design, Java, Spring Boot, React, Redux and microservices architecture. Beside that I am also serving as president at Toastmaster International club. Excellent communication, organization and interpersonal skills. Proficient in English, Gujarati and Hindi languages.

positions.title: Software Engineer Specialist
positions.description:
Work on cloud-based REST application by using Java to allow industrial businesses to run and configure analytics on valuable assets to prevent accidents, errors and to reduce maintenance costs. 
•	Implemented and tested complex algorithms to massage and manipulate external data to use in application. 
•	Architected backend for new features and created quarterly implementation plan for better delivery. 
•	Worked on Postgres database table design and persistence code. 
•	Implemented SQL script and microservice project to migrate old data. 
•	Participated in proof of concept for latest UI technology, and implemented UI using React and Redux.
•	Hosted Lunch and Learn session on Augmented Reality using Swift language. 
•	Participated in machine learning POC to identify machine learning platform.
•	Implemented adapter to convert machine learning platform output to the object analytics app understands. 
•	Worked on automation and JUnit to improve code quality.

positions.title: Undergrad Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Developed user friendly web application with backend implementation by using HTML, CSS, JQuery, Ajax, C and C++ to allow for demonstrating security features for Intel IOT platform, and to control these security operations
• Quickly adopted open source web frame REST application to create objects according to http request from frontend
• Developed JQuery and Ajax functions to send http GET and POST request to backend and receive back the output from hardware
• Implemented Makefile to compile C and C++ libraries together, and used socket programming and networking concepts to establish connection between client and server
• Created plan for Unit Test, and developed Unit Test for backend that talks to hardware from scratch by using cppUTest framework

positions.title: Junior Software Engineering intern
positions.description:
•	Worked on web application by using Ruby on Rails and testing frameworks, Rspec and Ruby Unit Test  
•	Designed algorithm and developed module for finding duplicate and canonical data by analyzing existing data
•	Developed module to create Sparkline graph using social data to display business trending graph on the website
•	Tested and validated ids and numbers of all social data in database, and tested some controller modules. Moreover, filled missing social data of businesses to get social score up, and collected geo location of region, zip code and locations

positions.title: CSE Tutor
positions.description:
•	Helped students who are struggling with labs, homework and concepts in CSE 140 and CSE 140L classes
•	Graded students’ final, midterms and homework papers, and gave them feedback
•	Discussed problems, concepts and grading rubric with teacher, other tutors and TAs in weekly meeting

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.locationName: 1700 West Hillsdale Blvd. San Mateo, CA 94402
positions.description:
•	Organized up to date data base 
•	Directed group members to handle display project by using new products 
•	Assisted students, faculty and staff to find books, merchandises and supplies 
•	Helped update new prices of books, merchandises and supplies in bookstore’s data  
•	Created many craft and art items to improve bookstore’s presentation
